title: Events alert — 2026-11-11
body:
Just landed: Siemens Energy FY26, today 07:00 Berlin / 01:00 ET — profit before specials doubled to €5.49bn on €44.2bn revenue (+15.5%), FCF €8.8bn, dividend tripled to €2.30, €9bn buyback; FY27 guide 14–16% growth and margin. XETRA opens 09:00 Berlin: supportive for the power sleeve (GEV, Hitachi, Quanta).

Yesterday's CPI was hot (+0.4% headline, +0.3% core vs +0.2% expected): Nasdaq −0.74%, 10y ~5.0%, December hike 84–88% priced. CoreWeave Q3 beat ($3.66bn revenue, +168% YoY; FY guide raised; +5–6% after hours) — session reaction at today's 15:30 Berlin open.

Tomorrow, Thu Nov 12: Nebius Q3 premarket (call 08:00 ET / 14:00 Berlin) — the debt-funded-backlog test; Siemens FY26 premarket; Applied Materials FQ4 after the US close.

Sleeves: power constructive; semis and infrastructure event-loaded; 15% cash holds.

Sources: web search 2026-11-11 (Reuters, CNBC, IBKR Campus, TipRanks, Nebius IR).
